selected_evidence.requirement: HTTPS on TCP 8443 returns the exact required content using system certificate trust
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, Apache was active and listening on 8443, the certificate verified against the system CA bundle, default-trust curl reported certificate verification successful, and HTTP 200 returned the exact required body.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID f9031a39-89d7-426a-ae19-a60bfdcd23e1, received native reboot acknowledgement, observed new boot ID c19bb7a0-6126-4562-b30c-a4eaa1bc97b5, confirmed the OS reached running state, and directly revalidated the service, firewall, certificate trust, HTTP 200 response, and persisted content.
